# Reliable Sprinkler

> > Manufacturer of UL/FM approved fire protection sprinklers, deluge valves, and preaction systems including PrePaK™ factory-assembled solutions.

Reliable Sprinkler specializes in engineered fire suppression equipment including concealed and institutional sprinklers, DDX/DDV deluge valves, grooved pipe connections, and floor control assemblies. The company provides technical documentation, Revit BIM tools, and comprehensive product lines for commercial, industrial, and critical facility applications.

## Key Topics

- Fire Protection Systems
- Fire Sprinklers & Sprinkler Heads
- Deluge & Preaction Valves
- K-Factor Ratings (5.6, 8.0, 11.2)
- DDX Deluge Valve
- DDV Deluge Valve
- PrePaK™ Factory-Assembled Systems
- UL/FM Approvals & UKCA Certification
- Concealed & Institutional Sprinklers
- Grooved Pipe Connections
- Floor Control Assemblies
- Revit BIM Integration
- Quick Response Sprinklers
- Stainless Steel Sprinklers
- High-Hazard Fire Suppression

## Deluge & Preaction Systems

- [Deluge Valves](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/products/system-valves/deluge): Deluge valve systems including DDV and DDX models for high-hazard areas
- [DDX Deluge Valve](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/ddx-deluge-valve): DDX hydraulic piston deluge valve for wet/dry pilot systems
- [PrePaK™ Systems for Critical Areas](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/prepak): PrePaK factory-assembled preaction/deluge systems with DDX valve

## Fire Sprinkler Heads

- [G6-80 HSW QREC Concealed Sidewall Sprinklers](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/g6-80-hsw-qr-ec): G6-80 HSW QREC concealed sidewall sprinkler with K-factor 8.0
- [F1FR56 Series Quick Response Sprinklers](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/f1fr56-series-quick-response-sprinklers): F1FR56 quick response sprinklers with K-factor 5.6, UL/FM approved
- [JL112 and J112 Upright, Pendent & Recessed Sprinklers](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/jl112-and-j112-upright-pendent-recessed): JL112/J112 upright, pendent & recessed sprinklers with K-factor 11.2
- [F1-SS Series Stainless Steel Sprinklers](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/f1-ss-series-stainless-steel-sprinklers): F1-SS stainless steel pendent/upright sprinklers for fire protection
- [G4 Series Concealed Pendent Sprinklers](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/model-g4-concealed): G4 flat concealed pendent sprinklers for fire suppression systems
- [XL Series Institutional Fire Sprinkler Heads](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/xl-series-institutional-sprinklers): XL institutional sprinklers for correctional and health facilities

## Valves & Control Assemblies

- [FCA2 Floor Control Assembly Valve](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/model-fca2-valve): FCA2 floor control ball valve assembly with test and drain

## Pipe Connections & Fittings

- [FLX1 Flexible Coupling](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/flx1-flexible-coupling): FLX1 UL-listed grooved flexible coupling with EPDM gasket
- [ECP1 Cap with Eccentric Hole FNPT](https://www.reliablesprinkler.com/product/ecp1-cap-with-eccentric-hole-fnpt): ECP1 pipe cap with eccentric hole and FNPT threading
